summary: The NIFTY index on two clients: an LTP holder, then a Quote holder (the desktop moves the touchline subscription from LTP to Quote with an unsubscribe and a subscribe); the snapshot and a partial serve both, each at its mode, with the change fields an index carries; the Quote holder leaving moves it back.

notes: Noren's index touchline carries no volume, average price, last quantity or totals.
Noren's own pc goes out as percent_change, as on the web; the desktop derives it only when a frame has none (audit FB-07).
Upstream the desktop answers an LTP-to-Quote change with u then t for the same touchline; the web sends nothing (both modes ride one touchline subscription).

deviations.reason: Noren's index touchline carries no average price; the web's Shoonya adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.

Noren's index touchline carries no last quantity; the web's Shoonya adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.

The web's Shoonya adapter forwards Noren's ltt as text (HH:MM:SS), or null when the frame has none; feed times are epoch milliseconds (docs), and a text copy of a time is not sent (docs/port/market-data-frames.md). The Noren family sends no ltt key (feed/dialect/names.rs).

Noren's index touchline carries no volume; the web's Shoonya adapter sends its safe_float/safe_int default (0) for a field the stream did not carry; the docs leave such a field out (web openalgo#2376, docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md), and so does the desktop.
